subject: Primelane security discovery — recap, evidence ask, and next steps
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@primelane.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@primelane.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Primelane security discovery — recap, evidence ask, and next steps

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick write-up to confirm what we heard, outline the evidence we can share, and propose next steps so your InfoSec and procurement teams have what they need. I kept this concise for your security reviewers.

What we heard (pain & scope)
- SOC 2: Required as part of your vendor acceptance; you want most recent Type II and summary of controls around data separation and key management.
- Audit logs: You need retention policy + export format and a sample schema for ingestion into PrimeLane SIEM.
- DPA & data flows: Clarify data residency and sub-processing; you asked for our DPA redlineable draft.
- Pen test & remediation: You want the latest pen test summary, date, and confirmation of open/closed remediation items.
- Timeline: Your procurement window target is mid-July (expected PO week of 7/19) — so security approval in the next 3–4 weeks would be ideal.

Evidence we can provide (attached / links)
- redwood_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf — our latest SOC 2 Type II report (summary encrypted; full support via NDA).
- audit_log_schema_sample.csv — sample export with field descriptions and retention metadata.
- dpa_draft_redwood.docx — editable DPA draft (we can accept a counterparty redline).
- pen_test_summary_2026.txt — high-level findings and remediation status; full report available under NDA.

Open questions from your side (please confirm)
1) Retention window: you mentioned 7 years during the call — is that the firm requirement across all logs or only for specific event types?
2) Is PrimeLane able to accept shared SSDR (secure share) for full SOC2/pen test reports, or do you require a signed NDA first?
3) Are there specific SIEM field mappings we should prioritize in the audit_log_schema_sample.csv?

Proposed next steps (we can move faster if helpful)
- I will: share attachments + Drive folder by EOD today (done, link below).
- Grace: will coordinate with Security to produce a 2–3 slide control summary for your reviewers.
- Lauren: will open a HubSpot deal record and log procurement milestone dates; she can sync contracts.
- From PrimeLane: confirm retention requirement and if your legal team wants to redline the DPA — then we can schedule a short follow-up with your security team (30–45 min).

Meeting slot: I’ve tentatively held 30 minutes on Tue 6/15 10:00am PT — if that still works we’ll use it to walk security through the artifacts.

Drive (evidence folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cprimelane-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/PL-2027-0042

Thanks — happy to refine this if I missed anything.

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
elliot@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf (PDF, summary), audit_log_schema_sample.csv (CSV), dpa_draft_redwood.docx (DOCX), pen_test_summary_2026.txt (TXT)

From: Priya Sharma <priya@primelane.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@primelane.com>, Avi Patel <avi.patel@primeconsult.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Primelane security discovery — recap, evidence ask, and next steps

Elliot —

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple clarifications from our side before we loop security/legal:

- Retention: for regulated transaction logs we need 7 years. For auth/access events we can accept 2 years; I will confirm and share the final matrix tomorrow.
- SOC 2: we can accept a secure share for the full Type II, NDA preferable but we can do a limited view first.
- Pen test: our security lead (Avi) will want the date of the test and whether the vendor performed remediation verification.
- SIEM fields: priority are timestamp, user_id (hashed ok), request_uri, response_code, geo_ip, and tokenized model_id.

We can confirm the legal redline on the DPA; I’ll get back by EOD Tue 6/15. The 6/15 10:00am PT slot works for Avi and me — we’ll plan to review artifacts and accept a short demo of audit log export.

Thanks — Priya
Head of Vendor Risk | PrimeLane
priya@primelane.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

---
On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 08:50 AM Avi Patel <avi.patel@primeconsult.com> wrote:
> Priya — adding myself here; quick note: we also need the CSV to show ISO8601 timestamps and UTC offsets.
> Avi

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Primelane security discovery — artifacts to prepare

Looping you both so security artifacts are owned and delivery timing is clear. Draft internal action items below — will update HubSpot.

- Lauren: create HubSpot milestone (Security Review Requested) and assign to Elliot — target 2027-06-15.
- Grace: produce a 1–2 page control summary and an access-control/keys note (ETA 6/15 AM).
- Elliot: confirm Drive folder permissions and add pen test summary + SOC2 redacted PDF (completed).
- Legal: route DPA draft to contracts once Priya’s redline arrives (Lauren to follow).

Quick note for Grace: Priya asked that user_id can be hashed; confirm we include an example hashed_id column in audit_log_schema_sample.csv. Also ensure timestamps are ISO8601 (Avi called that out).

Thanks — I’ll log these in the deal and ping procurement once security signs off.

Cheers,
Lauren
Enterprise Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@primelane.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@primelane.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Primelane security discovery — recap, evidence ask, and next steps

Hi all —

Thanks for confirming the slot. I’ll be on the call in 30 minutes. A couple quick clarifications I want recorded here so your reviewers have context:

- SOC 2 report: the attached PDF is a redacted summary; full Type II can be shared once NDA is in place (we have a standard mutual NDA template if helpful).
- Pen test: performed Oct 2026; vendor validated remediation for all high/critical items in Jan 2027. Full write-up is available under NDA; the summary (attached) lists status per finding.
- Audit logs: audit_log_schema_sample.csv includes an example hashed_user_id column and ISO8601 timestamps with timezone offsets. We also provide a JSON export option for SIEMs that prefer structured events.

Action items from our side (short-term)
- Send editable DPA to Priya for redline (Elliot) — done, link in Drive.
- Prepare 2-slide security summary for the meeting (Grace) — will present at the 10:00am PT call.
- Provide a one-click sample export from our console during the meeting to demonstrate retention/restore.

If anyone on the PrimeLane side would like the pen-test vendor contact for technical Q&A I can share it under NDA.

See you on the call,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: pen_test_summary_2026.txt, audit_log_schema_sample.csv, redwood_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf, dpa_draft_redwood.docx
